sloka: कुर्वन्ति कुसुमापीडान् शिरस्सु सुरभीनमी ।मेघप्रकाशै: फलकैर्दाक्षिणात्या यथा नरा: ॥ २.९३.१३॥
transliteration: kurvanti kusumāpīḍān śirassu surabhīnamī ।meghaprakāśai: phalakairdākṣiṇātyā yathā narā: ॥ 2.93.13॥

translations.english: Like the people of the south, the trees on the mountain ridges with branches, brilliant like clouds, are crowned with fragrant flowers as adornments.
